title: Docker Zero UI gallery
lede: Every window and state of the app as it looks today, rendered from the real Svelte frontend with the Go services replaced by fixed data. Mark each state Keep, Revise or Discuss to drive the redesign.
regenerate: uvx --from playwright --with pillow python -I <frontdoor-ui-gallery>/scripts/shoot.py render design/ui-gallery/gallery.json

popup.title: Tray popup
popup.opens: Click the tray icon, or launch the exe while it already runs.

corner.title: Corner box
corner.opens: Corner box switch in the popup, or Show corner box in the tray menu; stays on top at the bottom right.

settings.title: Settings
settings.opens: Gear in the popup, or Settings... in the tray menu.

maintenance.title: Settings: Portainer and Danger zone
maintenance.opens: Bottom of the Settings window, below the certificate.

setup.title: Setup
setup.opens: Opens by itself at launch while Ubuntu-24.04 is missing; Set up tile or Set up... link in the popup; Set up Docker Zero... in the tray menu.

states.title: Loading
states.how: The first moment after the popup opens, before a status arrives.
states.note: Start is enabled and the pill reads Stopped before any status is known.

states.title: Running
states.how: Distro, Docker and Portainer up; keepalive hold on.

states.title: Starting
states.how: Right after Start, until Portainer answers (up to 90 s).

states.title: Distro up, Portainer down
states.how: The container exited while the distro runs.
states.note: The pill reads Starting although nothing is starting.

states.title: Stopping
states.how: Right after Stop distro.

states.title: Stopped
states.how: Distro stopped by the user or by the WSL idle timeout.

states.title: Not installed
states.how: Before setup, or after Uninstall all.

states.title: WSL missing
states.how: WSL is not enabled on the machine.
states.note: The raw Go error is the only guidance; nothing says how to get WSL.

states.title: Confirm Shut down WSL
states.how: Shut down WSL clicked.

states.title: Start failed
states.how: Start clicked and Portainer did not answer in time.

states.title: Running
states.how: Portainer up.

states.title: Working
states.how: Any action in progress.

states.title: Stopped
states.how: Distro stopped.

states.title: Start failed
states.how: Start clicked and Portainer did not answer in time.
states.note: The error line is squeezed to zero height in the 96 px box, so a failed Start shows nothing.

states.title: Not installed
states.how: Corner box on while the distro is missing; Start clicked.
states.note: Offers Start, which can only fail, and the failure is not visible; no way to set up from here.

states.title: Loading
states.how: The first moment after the window opens.

states.title: All settings
states.how: Typical state after setup: auto start, shortcuts, keepalive, trusted certificate.

states.title: Everything off
states.how: Fresh portable run: no auto start, no shortcuts, WSL default idle.

states.title: .wslconfig mode pending
states.how: Never stop idle distros chosen; WSL has not restarted yet.

states.title: Confirm Apply now
states.how: Apply now... clicked.

states.title: Custom browser, no Chrome
states.how: Other browser chosen with Browse...; Chrome not installed.

states.title: Certificate not trusted
states.how: After setup, before Install (trust).

states.title: No certificate
states.how: Distro running but setup did not reach the certificate step.

states.title: Distro stopped
states.how: Settings opened while Ubuntu-24.04 is stopped; the certificate is not read.

states.title: Working
states.how: A setting is being applied.
states.note: Working... appears at the very bottom, out of view of the 680 px window.

states.title: Errors
states.how: A setting failed to apply, and two settings could not be read.
states.note: Errors land below the Danger zone, out of view of the item that failed.

states.title: Idle
states.how: Settings window scrolled to the bottom.

states.title: Updating
states.how: Update Portainer clicked; pull in progress.

states.title: Updated
states.how: A newer lts image was pulled and Portainer restarted.

states.title: Already latest
states.how: Update clicked with the image current.

states.title: Update failed
states.how: Docker Hub unreachable.

states.title: Reset form
states.how: Reset admin password... clicked.

states.title: Reset form: short password
states.how: Reset password clicked with the fields empty.

states.title: Reset: wrong username
states.how: Password replaced, but the username check failed.

states.title: Reset done
states.how: Password replaced and checked.

states.title: Uninstall plan
states.how: Uninstall all... clicked; backup on, no file yet.

states.title: Uninstall plan with backup file
states.how: Choose file... used.

states.title: Uninstall confirmation
states.how: Backup unticked, Continue clicked.

actions.click: Save a backup of Ubuntu-24.04 first

states.title: Uninstalling
states.how: Uninstall now clicked; backup export running.

states.title: Uninstall failed
states.how: The Windows certificate dialog was answered No.

states.title: Uninstalled
states.how: Every step finished; only Quit is left.

states.title: First run
states.how: First launch on a machine without Ubuntu-24.04.

states.title: Form error
states.how: Start setup clicked with the password empty.

states.title: Running
states.how: Setup in progress, third step.

states.title: Failed
states.how: A step failed; the form returns with Try again.

states.title: All set
states.how: Every step finished.
states.note: The steps, the log and the form fields stay above the result; the All set card is last.

states.title: Existing setup found
states.how: A setup made by hand from the old guide is detected.
states.note: The take-over card and the full setup form show together, though the card says setup is not needed.

states.title: Taken over
states.how: Take over clicked; every item replaced.

states.title: Take over failed
states.how: A legacy file was locked by another process.

states.title: Opened after setup
states.how: Set up... opened again on a machine Docker Zero already set up.
states.note: Reads Existing setup found / Nothing left to replace, above a form that would run setup again.

real.title: Setup, built exe, opened after setup
